required_cases.summary: A valid machine credential reaches PlanExecution, ExecutePlan, and ExecutePlanStream as the authenticated service principal.
Caller-supplied principal or tenant metadata cannot replace the authenticated context.
Missing, invalid, expired, wrong-resource, and insufficient-scope credentials are refused before provider contact.
The request carries an operator-approved logical model with no route override; policy resolves the canonical provider and model.
Provider credentials resolve from authenticated context and never appear in requests, events, errors, receipts, or diagnostics.
A provider tool-call stream is normalized without losing call id, tool name, or fragmented arguments.
Terminal execution exposes normalized usage and a receipt reference without raw provider response or credential material.
Provider failure records a bounded failed receipt and does not silently switch physical route.
A host retry is a distinct attempt under the same logical operation; automatic ambiguous replay is forbidden.
The community SQLite runtime accepts no caller-selected tenant and does not store tenant provider secrets.
